title: Resolve both sides of a contract change
prompt: Base build plan: {phases:[lint,unit,publish], publish:{tag:stable,sign:false}}. Upstream renamed lint to check, added verify-signature just before publish and requires sign:true. Topic inserts integration immediately after unit and changes tag to preview, without changing signing. Supply the merged phases (array) and publish (object) in a single JSON object. Keep execution order.

checks.label: Both upstream and topic phases in execution order
Keep upstream signing and topic release channel
